serie.subtitulo: Whole population and market-rate tenants, compared with the EU-27
serie.fuente: Eurostat (ilc_lvho07a, ilc_lvho07c), from the first year published: for Spain, the whole population since 2004 and market-rate renting since 2007; the EU-27, since 2010. From 2023 to 2025, the calculation from EU-SILC microdata reproduces these figures (±0.1 points).

serie.rupturas_atlas: Break in series set by the atlas, not flagged by Eurostat (hollow point and broken line): {lista}. Since the 2013 survey, INE has obtained income by combining the interview with administrative records (tax agency, Social Security and the foral treasuries), and income is the denominator of the rate.

desgloses.titulo: Spain by tenure, age and income
desgloses.subtitulo: EU-SILC microdata, own calculation · each figure with its sample
desgloses.nota: The under-18 and 15-to-29 groups overlap. «Owner» and «Tenant or rent-free» combine Eurostat’s categories.
desgloses.nota_quintil: Quintiles of equivalised disposable income (household income divided by its consumption units, modified OECD scale) of the whole population, weighted by person. Spain only: no quintile by country or by autonomous community.

comunidades.titulo: Communities on the map: figure and sample

metodo.hipoteca: Only mortgage interest counts, not capital repayments.
metodo.renta: Income refers to the year before the survey: the 2025 survey records 2024 incomes.
metodo.muestra: No confidence intervals: the public microdata do not include the sample design. Each INE figure carries its number of observations and the EU-SILC reliability flag: not published below 20; hatched from 20 to 49.
metodo.compuerta: The calculation reproduces Eurostat’s figures for Spain, each autonomous community, market-rate tenants and each age group (±0.1 points).
metodo.marcas: Eurostat figures carry their flags next to the value: b, break in series; u, low reliability (hatched on the map); e, estimate; p, provisional.

acceso.fuente: INE, EU-SILC {anio}, module on difficulties in accessing housing (published tables).

razones.condiciones: The conditions to rent or buy were not met

otras_cifras.titulo: Why it differs from other figures
otras_cifras.metodo: Other calculations add the whole mortgage payment or count households instead of people: they answer a different question.
otras_cifras.total: Outright owners dominate the total; the burden is concentrated among market-rate tenants.

renta_persona.definicion: Average disposable income of residents: total income net of taxes and contributions of all households in the tract, divided by its population.
renta_persona.calculo: Published by INE (ADRH) from tax records. Years published on another tract map are carried to the 2021 tracts as a population-weighted mean; where a tract has to be split, the status becomes «estimated».
renta_persona.lectura: Income for year t with population on 1 January of t + 1. Excludes imputed rent of owner-occupied housing. Published about 22 months after the reference year.

renta_hogar.definicion: Average disposable income of households in the tract.
renta_hogar.calculo: Published by INE (ADRH). On other tract maps, mean weighted by the number of households (population divided by average household size), with the same status rules as indicator 1.
renta_hogar.lectura: This is household income, often with several earners, not a wage. It is the denominator of resident rent burden (14) and the income of the «neighbourhood household» token.

renta_uc_mediana.definicion: Median disposable income per consumption unit (modified OECD scale): half of the tract population lives in households with lower equivalised income and half with higher.
renta_uc_mediana.calculo: Published by INE (ADRH) at each scale; medians are not aggregated. On other tract maps the value of a single source tract is copied (the same tract or one contributing at least 95% of street numbers); if none dominates, it is left blank.
renta_uc_mediana.lectura: Comparable across household sizes. It underlies the relative poverty thresholds (indicator 5).

peso_salarios.definicion: Share of the gross income of the tract's residents that comes from wages.
peso_salarios.calculo: Published by INE (ADRH, income by source: wages, pensions, unemployment benefits, other benefits and other income, adding up to 100). Years published on another tract map are carried to the 2021 tracts as a mean weighted by each tract's gross income (average gross income per person × population); where a tract has to be split, the status becomes «estimated». Municipalities, provinces, regions and Spain use the published figure.
peso_salarios.lectura: Links neighbourhood income to wages: a low share means income depends more on pensions, benefits or other income. No data for Álava until 2019, Gipuzkoa in 2015 or most of Navarre until 2020.

bajo_60_mediana.nombre: Population below 60% of median income per consumption unit
bajo_60_mediana.definicion: Population with income per consumption unit below 60% of the Spanish median (until 2022, the median of the common tax territory, without the Basque Country and Navarre).
bajo_60_mediana.calculo: Published by INE (ADRH, relative thresholds, both sexes). Years published on another tract map are carried to the 2021 tracts as a population-weighted mean, since the threshold is the same across Spain each year; where a tract has to be split, the status becomes «estimated». Municipalities, provinces, regions and Spain use the published figure.
bajo_60_mediana.lectura: National threshold, not regional: the same income counts the same everywhere, although living costs differ. Break in 2023: the threshold moves from the median of the common tax territory to that of all of Spain. No data for Álava until 2019, Gipuzkoa in 2015 or Navarre until 2020.

gini.definicion: Gini index of income per consumption unit in the tract: 0 if everyone has the same income, 100 if one person holds all of it.
gini.calculo: Published by INE (ADRH), which first replaces the lowest 1.5% and the highest 1.5% of incomes with the nearest value. On other tract maps the value of a single source tract is copied (the same tract or one contributing at least 95% of street numbers); if none dominates, it is left blank. Municipalities, provinces, regions and Spain use the published figure.
gini.lectura: Measures inequality within the neighbourhood, not between neighbourhoods. No data for Álava until 2019, Gipuzkoa in 2015 or Navarre until 2020.

salario_medio.nombre: Average annual wage per employee (total and under 35)
salario_medio.definicion: Average gross annual wage of employees with tax residence in the province, overall and aged 26 to 35.
salario_medio.calculo: Published by the Spanish Tax Agency (AEAT, Labour market and pensions in tax sources, table by province, age and sex): wages / employees, overall and for the 26 to 35 age band; regions and Spain, with their published figure. The Basque Country and Navarre are not covered (foral tax residence) and have no data.
salario_medio.lectura: Actual pay over the year: it includes people who worked only a few months. It is a mean, not a median; the «under-35» token converts it to a median with the median-to-mean ratio of the estimated average wage in its region, and then to monthly net pay spread over 12, with the employee's social security contribution and the average AEAT withholding by region and income band (plan §3.1, method B).

alquiler_mes.definicion: Median monthly rent of current main-residence tenancies in the tract, by building type (apartment and single-family); the first and third quartiles are also published.
alquiler_mes.calculo: Published by the Housing Ministry (SERPAVI) from rents declared in personal income tax and the Cadastre, on the 2021 tracts for the whole series. Not published with fewer than 10 tenancies.
alquiler_mes.lectura: Covers the whole rented stock, not new contracts: newcomers pay more. The Basque Country and Navarre join SERPAVI between 2021 and 2024.

alquiler_m2.definicion: Median monthly rent per square metre of current main-residence tenancies in the tract, by building type (apartment and single-family).
alquiler_m2.calculo: Published by the Housing Ministry (SERPAVI), using Cadastre floor area.
alquiler_m2.lectura: Allows comparing tracts with different dwelling sizes and underlies the pay needed (21).

var_alquiler.definicion: Annual change in the Rental Housing Price Index.
var_alquiler.calculo: Published by INE (IPVA), which follows the same tenancies and separates new from existing contracts.
var_alquiler.lectura: An index, not a price level: it shows trends, not how much is paid.

precio_compra_m2.definicion: Average price per square metre of housing sales signed before a notary.
precio_compra_m2.calculo: Published by the General Council of Notaries.
precio_compra_m2.lectura: A closing price, not an asking price or an appraisal.

valor_tasado_m2.definicion: Average appraised value per square metre of open-market housing.
valor_tasado_m2.calculo: Quarterly figure published by the Housing Ministry from mortgage appraisals; the year is the average of its four quarters weighted by the number of appraisals.
valor_tasado_m2.lectura: An appraisal value, not a price paid; only municipalities above 25,000 inhabitants.

precio_oferta.unidad: € per m² (rent: per m² per month)
precio_oferta.definicion: Average price per square metre in rental and sale listings.
precio_oferta.calculo: Taken from the portals’ aggregated press reports; never individual listings. A removable layer.
precio_oferta.lectura: An asking price: not combined with contracts, deeds or appraisals.

esfuerzo_residentes.definicion: Share of the average household’s annual income in the tract that the median rent of that same tract would take.
esfuerzo_residentes.calculo: Median monthly rent of flats × 12 / average net household income, same year, × 100. Census tract and municipality. If either term is confidential or missing, so is the result.
esfuerzo_residentes.lectura: Measures the vulnerability of current residents, not access: expensive areas look affordable because higher-income people live there.

barrera_acceso.definicion: Share of a token’s net monthly income (minimum wage, under-35, pensioner or the user’s own pay) that 50 m² of rent in the tract would take.
barrera_acceso.calculo: Median rent per m² of flats × 50 / token’s net monthly income spread over 12 payments, × 100. Computed in the browser for the chosen token, with the token’s income from the same year as the rent (each year’s minimum wage, under-35 pay and pension, 2015 to 2024); if the token lacks that year, the latest is used and this is stated.
barrera_acceso.lectura: Measures the barrier to moving in with a given income. Read by bands (up to 30%, 30–40% and over 40%), not as an exact figure.

anios_salario_compra.nombre: Years of wages to buy a home
anios_salario_compra.definicion: Years of reference gross pay needed to buy a standard dwelling.
anios_salario_compra.calculo: Appraised value per m² × standard floor area (80 m² by default) / average gross annual wage per employee (Tax Agency), same year; for a municipality, the wage of its province.
anios_salario_compra.lectura: Uses the appraised value, not the deed price, and ignores financing and down payment; see the theoretical mortgage burden (17). No data for the Basque Country and Navarre, which lack Tax Agency wages.

esfuerzo_hipotecario.definicion: Share of income taken by the first-year payment of a mortgage on a standard dwelling.
esfuerzo_hipotecario.calculo: First-year annual payment of a French-amortisation loan for 80% of the appraised value of 80 m², over 25 years at the year’s average home-mortgage rate (INE), divided by the average gross annual wage per employee (Tax Agency) of the same year, × 100.
esfuerzo_hipotecario.lectura: A theoretical burden: it assumes the remaining 20% and purchase costs are available.

hogares_alquiler.definicion: Households renting as a share of all households (main residences) in the tract.
hogares_alquiler.calculo: From INE’s 2021 (and 2011) Population and Housing Census, on the 2021 tracts.
hogares_alquiler.lectura: A snapshot at two dates, not an annual series.

viviendas_turisticas.nombre: Tourist dwellings as a share of all dwellings
viviendas_turisticas.definicion: Tourist dwellings as a share of all dwellings in the tract.
viviendas_turisticas.calculo: Tourist dwellings from INE’s experimental statistics (platform listings) over all dwellings in the 2021 Census, the denominator INE has used since August 2023. From February 2024, on the 2024 tracts, carried to the 2021 tracts with the conversion table; twice a year.
viviendas_turisticas.lectura: Measures pressure from tourist use. Numerator and denominator are not from the same year: dwellings are those of the 2021 Census. Reference months changed in 2024 (from February and August to May and November).

zona_tensionada.definicion: Municipality or area declared a stressed residential market zone.
zona_tensionada.calculo: Declarations published in official gazettes under Law 12/2023, with their effective date.
zona_tensionada.lectura: A public policy layer, not a market measure.

sueldo_necesario.nombre: Net monthly pay needed to stay under the threshold
sueldo_necesario.definicion: Net monthly pay needed so that 50 m² of rent in the tract does not exceed 30% of pay.
sueldo_necesario.calculo: Median rent per m² of flats × 50 / 0.30 (floor area can be changed to 70 or 90 m² and the threshold to 40%). Carries the status of the rent figure.
sueldo_necesario.lectura: It is rent expressed in another unit, not a new indicator. The 30% threshold draws on the stressed-zone criterion of Law 12/2023, which uses household income and utilities; it is not that criterion.

sobrecarga.definicion: People living in households whose total housing costs, net of housing allowances, exceed 40% of disposable income, also net of allowances.
sobrecarga.calculo: EU-SILC microdata (INE) with Eurostat’s method: only mortgage interest counts; previous-year income; person weights. Reproduces Eurostat figures (±0.1 points). Region × tenure and age breakdowns pool three waves.
sobrecarga.lectura: Measures the burden on those already housed; outright owners dominate it and it misses people unable to leave home. Read it alongside unsuccessful housing search (23) and by tenure, especially market-rate renting.

busqueda_sin_exito.definicion: People aged 16 and over who actively looked for housing in the last 12 months without moving.
busqueda_sin_exito.calculo: Published by INE in the tables of the 2025 EU-SILC module on housing access difficulties, with the main reason (mostly price).
busqueda_sin_exito.lectura: A one-off measure (2025). It captures those trying to move in and failing, unlike the overburden rate.

contratos_alquiler.definicion: Number of current main-residence tenancies from which SERPAVI computes the area's median rent, by building type (apartment and single-family).
contratos_alquiler.calculo: Count published by the Housing Ministry (SERPAVI). With fewer than 10 tenancies the median is not published; 0 means there are no registered rental contracts, which is not the same as «no data».
contratos_alquiler.lectura: Shows how many tenancies support the median: with fewer than 30, the tract profile flags «few contracts». It accompanies 8, 9, 14, 15 and 21 and has no map of its own.

margen_alquiler_mes.nombre: Approximate margin of the median monthly rent
margen_alquiler_mes.definicion: Approximate standard error of the median monthly rent (8), as a percentage of the median, by building type.
margen_alquiler_mes.calculo: 0.929 × (P75 − P25) / (P50 × √n), using the SERPAVI quartiles and tenancies (n); only where the median is published (10 or more tenancies).
margen_alquiler_mes.lectura: Order of magnitude of the noise in the median: it assumes a regular distribution within the area and does not correct for current rather than new tenancies. It accompanies 8 and 14.

margen_alquiler_m2.nombre: Approximate margin of the median rent per m²
margen_alquiler_m2.definicion: Approximate standard error of the median rent per square metre (9), as a percentage of the median, by building type.
margen_alquiler_m2.calculo: 0.929 × (P75 − P25) / (P50 × √n), using the SERPAVI rent-per-m² quartiles and tenancies (n); only where the median is published (10 or more tenancies).
margen_alquiler_m2.lectura: It also applies to 15 and 21, which are rent per m² in another unit: the profile gives the pay needed with its range and warns when «Can you make rent?» sits on the edge between two bands.

fuentes.ine_hipotecas: Mortgage Statistics (H): average initial interest rate
fuentes.portales: Asking-price reports (Idealista and Fotocasa press rooms)
fuentes.aeat_mercado_trabajo: Labour market and pensions in tax sources
fuentes.boe_smi: Royal Decree on the minimum wage
fuentes.zonas_tensionadas: Declarations of stressed residential market zones
fuentes.ign_au: IGN administrative units (BDDAE): condominiums and territories outside any province
fuentes.ine_callejero: Electoral census street directory (street segments by tract)
fuentes.ine_padron_sc: Population by census tract (annual population census; municipal register)
fuentes.ine_ecv_modulo: Living Conditions Survey 2025: housing access difficulties module (tables)
fuentes.eurostat_ilc_lvho07: Housing cost overburden rate (ilc_lvho07a, ilc_lvho07b, ilc_lvho07c)
fuentes.eurostat_ilc_lvho07_r: Housing cost overburden rate by NUTS 2 region (ilc_lvho07_r)

fuentes.ine_epa_deciles: Wage deciles of the main job (Labour Force Survey)
